## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, affected scope, and relevant issue or requirement IDs.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. State skipped checks and missing prerequisites explicitly.

- [ ] No credentials, sessions, real manuscripts, backups, or private logs are included.
- [ ] Any changed third-party material retains its source, license, and integrity records.
- [ ] Relevant behavior, compatibility, and documentation were checked.

The lightweight CI checks buildability, selected service-free tests, and isolated Windows entry points. It does not qualify a complete Windows installation, database/Temporal workflows, external tools, real model behavior, or long-form literary quality.
